full_text_zh:
[P1] 大脚丫跳芭蕾
文／图：〔美〕埃米·扬  翻译：柯倩华
河北教育出版社

[P2] 大脚丫
跳芭蕾
文／图〔美〕埃米·扬  翻译 柯倩华
河北教育出版社

[P3] 有一个跳芭蕾舞的女孩名叫贝琳达。

[P4] 贝琳达喜欢跳舞。她每天去舞蹈学校，
认真地练舞。她跳舞的时候，姿态优雅、脚
步轻巧灵活。

[P5] 可是，贝琳达有个大问题，嗯，
应该说有两个大问题：

就是她的左脚和右脚。

[P6] 其实贝琳达不觉得自己的脚有问题，可是参加一年一度的芭蕾舞表演选拔时，问题就来了。

[P7] 评审委员一看到她的脚就大叫：
“暂停！”

[P8] “天啊！”贾庄董男爵三世说。“你的脚大得像条船！”
著名的纽约评论家乔治·根毕崇说：“简直和海豹的鳍没两样！”
常在舞蹈杂志上发表文章的欧娜·劳马拍女士瞪着眼睛直摇头。

贝琳达还没试跳，评审们就说：“回去吧。你那一双脚，永远跳不好！”

冰凉花雨收集整理
更多精彩尽在http://mysweetmoon.taobao.com/

[P9] 贝琳达很难过，难过了好久好久。

[P10] 她想：“或许那些评审委员说得对，我的大脚真的不适合跳舞。”

[P11] 于是，贝琳达不跳舞了。
她告诉自己：“我放弃跳芭蕾舞吧。”
费莱迪餐厅
征人启事
室内乐团！
即将登场！
既然不再跳舞，她就得找别的事做。可是，她除了跳舞，什么都不会。她找啊找，终于在费莱迪餐厅找到工作。

[P12] 餐厅里的
客人喜欢她，
因为她动作
快、脚步轻
巧灵活。

费莱迪先生也
喜欢她，因为她做
事很认真。

[P13] 贝琳达喜欢费莱迪先生和餐厅里的
客人，不过她还是忘不了跳舞。

[P14] 有一天，有个乐团来餐厅表演。他们自称“费莱迪好友乐团”。在餐厅开门营业前，他们先练了一首轻快的曲子。

[P15] 贝琳达的脚尖忍不住一上一下地跟着打拍子。

[P16] 接着，他们开始演奏浪漫又抒情的乐曲，不知不觉中……
贝琳达跳起舞来了！
冰凉花雨收集整理
更多精彩童在http://mysweetmoon.taobao.com/

[P17] 这些音乐家每天到餐厅演奏，贝琳达每天
趁客人还没上门，就随着他们的音乐跳舞。

有一天，费莱迪先生问贝琳达愿不愿意跳
给客人看。贝琳达微笑着回答：“噢，当然好啊！”

[P18] 餐厅里的客人都很喜欢她的表演。他们高兴地去告诉他们的朋友，那些朋友第二天就来到费莱迪餐厅。

他们也非常喜欢……

[P19] 他们又告诉其他朋友。很快地，每天都有很多人来费莱迪餐厅看贝琳达跳舞。

[P20] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥听说了这件事，他的朋友的朋友叫他一定要去看贝琳达跳舞。他去了。

[P21] 他很惊讶。
他非常赞赏。
他觉得好感动。

[P22] “你一定要来大都会剧院表演！”他激动地说，“请你答应我！”
贝琳达笑着回答：
“噢，当然好啊！”餐厅里的客人都鼓掌欢呼起来。

[P23] 就这样，贝琳达到了大都会剧院，随着“费莱迪好友乐团”美妙的音乐翩翩起舞。她好喜欢跳舞！评审委员们大喊：“太精彩了！多么像燕子、鸽子、羚羊啊！”
他们全神贯注地看她跳舞，完全没有注意到她的脚有多大。

[P24] 贝琳达快乐极了。因为她可以跳舞，
跳舞，

[P25] 一直跳舞。

[P26] 至于评审委员们说什么，她一点也不在乎了！
full_text_en:
[P1] Big Feet Dancing Ballet
Text & Illustrations: [USA] Amy Young  Translator: Ke Qianhua
Hebei Education Press

[P2] Big Feet
Ballet
Text & Illustrations by [USA] Amy Young  Translated by Ke Qianhua
Hebei Education Press

[P3] There was a girl who danced ballet, and her name was Bellinda.

[P4] Belinda loves to dance. She goes to dance school every day,
practicing diligently. When she dances, her posture is graceful and her steps are light and nimble.

[P5] But, Belinda had a big problem, well,
should say two big problems:

Her left foot and her right foot.

[P6] Actually, Bellinda didn't think there was anything wrong with her feet, but when she participated in the annual ballet performance audition, the problem arose.

[P7] The judges screamed as soon as they saw her feet:
"Stop!"

[P8] "Oh my!" said Baron Jia Zhuangdong III. "Your feet are as big as a ship!"
Famous New York critic George Genbichong said, "They're just like a seal's flippers!"
The lady who often writes articles for dance magazines, Oona Laomaipai, stared with her eyes wide open and shook her head.

Before Belinda even tried to dance, the judges said, "Go back. Those feet of yours will never be able to dance!"

Collected and organized by Bingliang Hua Yu
More wonderful content at http://mysweetmoon.taobao.com/

[P9] Belle was very sad, and she stayed sad for a long, long time.

[P10] She thought: 'Maybe the judges were right. My big feet really aren't suited for dancing.'

[P11] So, Belinda stopped dancing.
She told herself, "I'm giving up ballet." 
Fei Lai Di Restaurant
Help Wanted
Indoor Orchestra!
Coming Soon!
Since she no longer danced, she had to find something else to do. But she could do nothing except dance. She searched and searched, and finally found a job at Fei Lai Di Restaurant.

[P12] The guests in the restaurant liked her,
because she moved quickly and had light, nimble steps.

Mr. Freddie also liked her, because she was very serious and diligent in her work.

[P13] Belinda liked Mr. Freddy and the guests in the restaurant, but she still couldn't forget dancing.

[P14] One day, a band came to the restaurant to perform. They called themselves the 'Freddy Friends Band'. Before the restaurant opened for business, they practiced a lively tune.

[P15] Belinda's toes couldn't help but tap along to the beat, up and down.

[P16] Then, they began to play a romantic and emotional piece of music, and before they knew it...
Belinda started dancing!
Ice Cool Flower Rain Collection and Organization
More wonderful children's books at http://mysweetmoon.taobao.com/

[P17] These musicians come to the restaurant every day to play, and Belinda dances along to their music every day before the guests arrive.

One day, Mr. Fredi asked Belinda if she would like to dance for the guests. Belinda smiled and replied, "Oh, of course!"

[P18] The customers in the restaurant all loved her performance. They happily told their friends, and those friends came to Freddy's restaurant the next day.

They loved it too...

[P19] They told their other friends. Soon, every day, many people came to Freddy's Restaurant to watch Belinda dance.

[P20] The conductor of the Metropolitan Ballet heard about this. His friend's friend told him he must go see Belinda dance. He went.

[P21] He was very surprised.
He admired her greatly.
He felt deeply moved.

[P22] "You must come perform at the Metropolitan Theater!" he said excitedly. "Please promise me!"
Belinda smiled and replied:
"Oh, of course!" The guests in the restaurant clapped and cheered.

[P23] This way, Belinda arrived at the Metropolitan Theater, dancing gracefully to the beautiful music of the 'Freddie Friends Band'. She loved dancing! The judges shouted, 'Wonderful! So much like a swallow, a dove, a gazelle!'
They were completely absorbed in watching her dance, not noticing at all how big her feet were.

[P24] Belinda was overjoyed. Because she could dance,
dance,

[P25] Keep dancing.

[P26] As for what the judges said, she didn't care at all!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大脚丫跳芭蕾》的封面，展示了一位穿着粉色芭蕾舞裙、脚踩粉色舞鞋的卡通人物正在优雅起舞，背景为深红色，下方标注了作者、译者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《大脚丫跳芭蕾》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者和出版社信息，背景为红色幕布和黄色舞台，左侧有角色探头窥视。
[P3] 本页介绍了一个名叫贝琳达的女孩，她正在跳芭蕾舞，画面中她穿着粉色舞裙，脚踩舞鞋，站在黄色舞台上，姿态优雅。
[P4] 本页介绍了贝琳达热爱跳舞，每天去舞蹈学校认真练习，跳舞时姿态优雅、脚步灵活。
[P5] 本页指出贝琳达跳舞时面临的大问题——她的左脚和右脚，画面中她双手叉腰，表情略显无奈，突出其脚部特征。
[P6] 本页描述了贝琳达虽然不认为自己的脚有问题，但在参加一年一度的芭蕾舞表演选拔时，问题终于显现了。画面展示了一个舞台，红色幕布拉开，观众席中有人在观看，右侧有角色探头窥视。
[P7] 评审委员在看到贝琳达的脚后，立刻大叫‘暂停！’，表现出震惊和拒绝的态度。
[P8] 贝琳达在芭蕾舞选拔中还未开始表演，评审们就因她巨大的脚而嘲笑并拒绝她，认为她永远跳不好芭蕾舞。
[P9] 贝琳达因被拒绝参加芭蕾舞选拔而感到非常难过，独自在浴缸里沉思，画面表现了她的失落与孤独。
[P10] 贝琳达站在镜子前，看着自己巨大的脚，开始怀疑评审委员的话，认为自己的大脚可能真的不适合跳舞。
[P11] 贝琳达因被拒绝参加芭蕾舞选拔而放弃跳舞，她告诉自己放弃芭蕾舞，并在费莱迪餐厅找到了一份工作。
[P12] 贝琳达在费莱迪餐厅工作，客人喜欢她动作快、脚步轻巧灵活，餐厅老板费莱迪先生也喜欢她，因为她做事认真。
[P13] 贝琳达在费莱迪餐厅工作，虽然她喜欢老板和客人，但内心依然无法忘记跳舞。
[P14] 一个名为“费莱迪好友乐团”的乐队来到餐厅，在营业前练习了一首轻快的曲子。
[P15] 贝琳达在餐厅工作时，听到乐队练习的音乐，忍不住用脚尖跟着节奏打拍子，表现出她内心对舞蹈的渴望。
[P16] 乐队演奏浪漫抒情的音乐，贝琳达情不自禁地跳起舞来，表现出她内心对舞蹈的热爱与释放。
[P17] 贝琳达每天在餐厅客人未到前，随着乐队音乐跳舞。一天，餐厅老板费莱迪先生询问她是否愿意为客人跳舞，她欣然同意。
[P18] 贝琳达在餐厅为客人跳舞，受到顾客喜爱，他们纷纷推荐朋友前来，餐厅因此吸引了更多客人。
[P19] 顾客们将贝琳达跳舞的消息告诉朋友，很快每天都有很多人来到费莱迪餐厅观看她跳舞，餐厅变得热闹非凡。
[P20] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥听说了贝琳达在餐厅跳舞的事，被朋友的朋友劝说后，决定前去观看。
[P21] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥观看贝琳达跳舞，被她的舞姿深深打动，表现出惊讶、赞赏和感动的情绪。
[P22] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥邀请贝琳达去剧院表演，她欣然答应，餐厅里的客人们为她鼓掌欢呼。
[P23] 贝琳达在大都会剧院的舞台上随着乐队音乐翩翩起舞，评审委员们被她的舞姿深深吸引并大加赞赏，观众们全神贯注，无人注意到她脚的大小。
[P24] 贝琳达因能跳舞而感到非常快乐，画面中她身着粉色舞裙，正在翩翩起舞。
[P25] 画面中贝琳达身着粉色舞裙，在空中优雅跳跃，下方文字写着“一直跳舞”，表现她对舞蹈的持续热爱与享受。
[P26] 贝琳达在聚光灯下抱着一束红玫瑰，面带微笑，表现出她对评审意见的毫不在意，享受着舞蹈带来的快乐与认可。
[P27] 画面中，贝琳达身着粉色舞裙，怀抱一束红玫瑰，面带微笑，被一个心形边框包围，背景为粉红色，表现出她对舞蹈的热爱与满足。
